dart.rights_scope: OpenDART permits extraction of desired XML data. Bounded private facts only for uncorrected FORMULA6.2/20260723 ACODE11335 trust termination decisions. Excludes raw documents, images, signatures and attachments. Decisions, scheduled termination and share custody are not completed termination or cancellation of shares. Source-slot evidence alone grants no live HTTP permission.
dart.private_retention_basis: Fixed-host latest listing plus XML ZIP in private run memory. Manual recipient-encrypted diagnostics retain one day; ignored local0700/0600 only. No raw public redistribution. Exact XML fields in paragraph <=1200 characters; image/signature/contact/attachment tables excluded.
